title: Deliver Gold to Cufingford Bank
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Gold** delivered to **Cufingford Bank** (industry id 18, near tile 162,217).

A likely supplier is **Plonnway Gold Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 166,169); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **320 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
